sn43.1:1.2: asaṅkhatañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ.
sn43.1:2.1: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ desito asaṅkhatagāmī maggo.
sn43.1:2.2: yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā
sn43.1:2.3: etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyatha bhikkhave, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ kho amhākaṃ anusāsanī.
